{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, deep burgundy #6D1F3A, merino wool
Midi skirt, A-line with soft pleats, mid-calf length, emerald green #046A4D, jacquard-textured crepe
Tailored coat, single-breasted, straight cut, knee length, camel #C19A6B, wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, pointed toe, mid block heel, black #1A1A1A, smooth leather
Sheer tights, black #1C1C1C, fine nylon
Sculptural drop earrings, antique gold #C9A24B, brushed metal
Small structured clutch, gold #B8893A, textured leather

This outfit works because the burgundy and emerald pairing is rich and unexpected, which makes you stand out in a theatre foyer while the pieces stay refined and neat. The jacquard texture of the skirt catches the warm artificial light and gives movement as you walk. The camel coat adds a calm, polished frame for the bold colors and keeps you warm on an autumn evening. Heeled ankle boots and gold accents make the look feel evening-ready and comfortable through a 19:00 performance."}
